title: Should Students Wear Uniforms?
text:
In my opinion, students should wear school uniforms. Uniforms are cheap because families do not need to buy many different clothes. They also help students feel equal, because nobody can show expensive clothes. Some people think uniforms are boring, but I disagree.

Some students say that uniforms stop them from expressing themselves. However, schools can allow small choices, such as the colors of shoes or bags. In my view, this is a good balance. Therefore, I believe uniforms are a good idea for every school.

questions.text: According to the writer, why are uniforms cheap?
options: Schools sell them at a discount.
Families do not need to buy many different clothes.

questions.text: What do some students say about uniforms?
options: They are too warm in summer.
They stop students from expressing themselves.

options: The writer thinks uniforms are boring.

questions.text: Why does the writer suggest allowing small choices?
options: To avoid having any rules at school.
To show that the school is rich.
To find a balance between rules and personal expression.

paragraph_translations: Na minha opinião, os alunos devem usar uniforme escolar. Os uniformes são baratos porque as famílias não precisam comprar muitas roupas diferentes. Eles também ajudam os alunos a se sentirem iguais, porque ninguém pode mostrar roupas caras. Algumas pessoas acham os uniformes sem graça, mas eu discordo.

Alguns alunos dizem que os uniformes impedem que eles se expressem. No entanto, as escolas podem permitir pequenas escolhas, como a cor dos sapatos ou das bolsas. Na minha opinião, isso é um bom equilíbrio. Portanto, eu acredito que o uniforme é uma boa ideia para todas as escolas.
